description: The Christmas party at Ijuin's house: all of SERIFU/XMAS.BIN (base 0x80197000; game-internals 6t), 357 of 358 strings; the centered '・' pause stays. 13 sections from SHOUGATU.EXN's tables at 0x80145AD0 (tools/geko_sections.py --xmas): 0 Yuko, 1 Shiori, 2 Yuina, 3 Ayako, 4 Mira, 5 Mio, 6 Yukari, 7 Nozomi, 8 Megumi, 9 Saki, 10 the present exchange, 11 the arrival, Ijuin's speeches and the evening at home, 12 Yumi. Each girl has a chat ('Talked to {G}'), a brush-off and, for an unmet girl, her first meeting; Megumi is introduced by Shiori or visits the player at home with a present. The 'strings' entries translate SHOUGATU.EXN's in-place words the party code strcpy's: the butler's labels (黒服 -> Guard, 外井 -> Sotoi), Ijuin's label and the banners Ijuin's, Party Hall and Local Park. Verified in DuckStation on forced parties (force_christmas.py --party via xmas_run.ps1; docs/testing.md 'The Christmas party'): all three ways in (polite, Sotoi's physique lines, 'you've come again') and being turned away with the evening at home and Megumi's visit; Ijuin's speeches for the first, second and third party; Shiori's chat, her hostile variant and her introducing Megumi; the first meetings of every girl but Yumi (who has none); chats of Yuko, Nozomi, Megumi and Yumi; brush-offs of Yuina, Ayako, Mira and Nozomi; presents of Shiori (score, cup), Yuina (reactor), Saki (candy), Mira (fan club kit), Yuko (koala), Megumi (crocodile) and Ijuin (signed photo, poster); both closing thoughts. Checked only statically: the other chats and brush-offs, the player's 'we haven't even talked' after a brush-off (not shown in the forced runs), the other presents and the alternative lines of two-string present parts (e.g. Ijuin's poster 'Nah'), the Ijuin's and Local Park banners, natural triggers.

lines.original:
毎年気になってたんだけど、
そのカクテルグラスの中に
何が入ってるんだ？
lines.text:
I've wondered every year.
What's in that
cocktail glass?

lines.original:
はーっはっはっはっ。
無知な庶民に教えてやろう。
この中身はな…。
lines.text:
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
I'll tell you, commoner.
What's inside is...

lines.original: この中身は…。
lines.text: What's inside is...

lines.original:
君には、教えてやらん。
ま、アルコールでは無い
とだけ言っておこうか。
lines.text:
I won't tell you.
I'll just say
it's not alcohol.

lines.original:
未成年は飲酒をしては
いけないからね。
lines.text:
Minors mustn't drink,
after all.

lines.original:
そ、そんなことは、
知ってるよ。
だったら何なんだよ。
lines.text:
I-I know that
already.
So what is it?

lines.original:
死ぬまで考えるがいい。
はーっはっはっはっ。
では、失礼するよ。
lines.text:
Ponder it till you die.
Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!
Now, if you'll excuse me.

lines.original:
どうせ、
ジュースのくせに…。
lines.text:
Bet it's
just juice...

lines.original: ふぅ、家に着いたぞ。
lines.text: Phew, I'm back home.

lines.original:
仕方ない、今年は一人で
クリスマスを祝うか。
lines.text:
Oh well. This year I'll
celebrate Christmas alone.

lines.original:
メリークリスマス！！
あぁ、楽しいなぁ。
lines.text:
Merry Christmas!!
Ah, what fun.

lines.original:
うぅ、来年こそは
楽しいクリスマスを
過ごすぞ。
lines.text:
Ugh... Next year, I'll
have a fun Christmas
for sure.

lines.original: 招待されてたんですね。
lines.text: So you were invited too.

lines.original:
優美ちゃんも、
来てたのか。
lines.text:
Yumi, you
came too?

lines.original: しばらく{G}と話し込んだ
lines.text: Talked to {G}

lines.original:
同級生のお友達と
来てるから、
そろそろ、行かなくちゃ。

いいよ気にしないで。
それじゃ、また。
lines.text:
Sure, don't worry.
See you later.

lines.original: あっ…。
lines.text: Oh...

lines.original:
優美ちゃんも来てたのか。
でも、何もあんなに
走らなくても…。
lines.text:
So Yumi came too.
But she didn't have
to run off like that...
